tool_input.command: echo "SDLC_GATE_COMMANDS=$SDLC_GATE_COMMANDS"; env | grep -i CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; env | grep -i SDLC
tool_input.description: Check CI environment variables for gate commands

tool_input.command:
grep -n "short test summary info" -A2 "$TMPDIR/pytest_full.log" | tail -5
grep -E "^[0-9]+ passed|passed,|failed,|error" "$TMPDIR/pytest_full.log" | tail -3
awk '/= .*passed|= .*failed|= .*error/' "$TMPDIR/pytest_full.log" | tail -3
tool_input.description: Extract the exact final summary counts

tool_input.command:
{ time python -m pytest -q --tb=no > "$TMPDIR/pytest_summary2.log" 2>&1; echo "EXITCODE=$?"; } 2> "$TMPDIR/pytest_time.log"
echo "---time---"
cat "$TMPDIR/pytest_time.log"
echo "---tail of summary2---"
python -c "
with open('$TMPDIR/pytest_summary2.log') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()
print('total lines', len(lines))
for l in lines[-5:]:
    print(repr(l))
"
tool_input.description: Time the pytest run and inspect its true tail

tool_input.command:
python -m compileall -q plugin tests tasks.py; echo "compileall exit=$?"
echo "---ruff check---"
python -m ruff check .
echo "ruff check exit=$?"
echo "---ruff format---"
python -m ruff format --check .
echo "ruff format exit=$?"
tool_input.description: Run compileall and ruff across the whole repo

tool_input.command:
python - <<'EOF'
import sys, json, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "plugin")
from pr.description import _conformance_line
from state.unpark import risk_hits
import pathlib

# _conformance_line: declared drops clause present
gate_json = {
    "checks": [
        {"name": "plan_sync", "ok": True, "reason": "", "details": {}},
        {"name": "ratchets", "ok": True, "reason": "", "details": {"declared": [{"name": "ratchet: tests", "source": "plan"}]}},
    ]
}
print("with declared drops:", _conformance_line(gate_json, "", "c"))

# clause absent when no declared drops
gate_json2 = {
    "checks": [
        {"name": "plan_sync", "ok": True, "reason": "", "details": {}},
        {"name": "ratchets", "ok": True, "reason": "", "details": {"declared": []}},
    ]
}
print("without declared drops:", _conformance_line(gate_json2, "", "c"))

# phase (a)/(b): ratchets clause should not even apply (different code path)
print("phase a:", _conformance_line({"checks": []}, "## Open questions from intent\n- none\n", "a"))

# risk_hits: union of risk_list and ratchets hits, including ratchets-only record
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    change_dir = pathlib.Path(d)
    gate_c = {
        "checks": [
            {"name": "ratchets", "ok": False, "details": {"hits": {"ratchet: tests": ["tests/test_x.py"]}}},
        ]
    }
    (change_dir / "evidence").mkdir()
    (change_dir / "evidence" / "gate-c.json").write_text(json.dumps(gate_c))
    print("risk_hits ratchets-only:", risk_hits(change_dir, "c"))

    gate_c2 = {
        "checks": [
            {"name": "risk_list", "ok": False, "details": {"hits": {"tests": ["x"]}}},
            {"name": "ratchets", "ok": False, "details": {"hits": {"ratchet: tests": ["tests/test_x.py"]}}},
        ]
    }
    (change_dir / "evidence" / "gate-c.json").write_text(json.dumps(gate_c2))
    print("risk_hits union:", risk_hits(change_dir, "c"))
EOF

mkdir -p "$TMPDIR/riskhits_test/evidence" && python -c "
import sys, json, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, 'plugin')
from state.unpark import risk_hits

change_dir = pathlib.Path('$TMPDIR/riskhits_test')
gate_c = dict(checks=[
    dict(name='ratchets', ok=False, details=dict(hits={'ratchet: tests': ['tests/test_x.py']})),
])
(change_dir / 'evidence' / 'gate-c.json').write_text(json.dumps(gate_c))
print('ratchets-only:', risk_hits(change_dir, 'c'))

gate_c2 = dict(checks=[
    dict(name='risk_list', ok=False, details=dict(hits={'tests': ['x']})),
    dict(name='ratchets', ok=False, details=dict(hits={'ratchet: tests': ['tests/test_x.py']})),
])
(change_dir / 'evidence' / 'gate-c.json').write_text(json.dumps(gate_c2))
print('union:', risk_hits(change_dir, 'c'))
"
rm -rf "$TMPDIR/riskhits_test"
tool_input.description: Exercise risk_hits directly using a temp evidence file

tool_input.command:
python -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'plugin')
from gate.checks import RATCHET_PROOF_RE, _ratchet_path_declared

# Proof-line declaration
proof = '- ratchet: tests may fall, because the old suite moved to a new file\n'
print('proof declares tests:', bool(RATCHET_PROOF_RE['tests'].search(proof)))
print('proof declares evals:', bool(RATCHET_PROOF_RE['evals'].search(proof)))

# Files-that-change declaration: a dropped test file path listed verbatim
planned = ['tests/test_x.py']
print('file declared in Files that change:', _ratchet_path_declared('tests/test_x.py', planned, {}, 'evals/cases/'))

# Eval-case directory declared with trailing slash
case_paths = {'case1': ['evals/cases/case1/input.json']}
planned2 = ['evals/cases/case1/']
print('case dir declared with trailing slash:', _ratchet_path_declared('evals/cases/case1/', planned2, case_paths, 'evals/cases/'))

# Undeclared case
print('case dir undeclared:', _ratchet_path_declared('evals/cases/case2/', [], {'case2': ['evals/cases/case2/input.json']}, 'evals/cases/'))
"
